use_when: 联系人
通讯录
联系人选择器
联系人增删改查
如何使用Picker方式让用户选择联系人
如何通过Picker拉起新建联系人界面并保存联系人
如何在应用中实现联系人的增删改查操作
如何申请READ_CONTACTS和WRITE_CONTACTS权限
如何使用contact.selectContacts接口拉起联系人选择列表
当你的应用需要让用户从通讯录中选择联系人时（如发送消息、分享内容、邀请好友等场景），可以使用Picker方式拉起联系人列表，无需申请敏感权限即可完成操作
当你的应用属于需要直接管理联系人数据的场景（如通讯录管理应用、企业通讯录应用等），且已获得受限开放权限，可以使用联系人管理API直接进行联系人的增加、删除、修改和查询操作
在应用里弹出系统联系人列表让用户选择收件人 / Open the system contact picker for the user to choose recipients
实现选择多个联系人并返回姓名和手机号 / Let users pick multiple contacts and return names and phone numbers
接入联系人选择器用于分享、邀请或转发场景 / Integrate a contact picker for share, invite, or forward flows
拉起新建联系人页面并预填号码后保存到通讯录 / Launch the add-contact page with a prefilled number and save it
把表单里的姓名和电话保存为新的系统联系人 / Save a name and phone from a form as a new system contact
读取通讯录中的联系人详情用于展示姓名、电话和邮箱 / Read contact details from the address book to display name, phone, and email
按姓名或号码搜索本机联系人 / Search local contacts by name or phone number
实现联系人数据的新增、编辑、删除和查询管理 / Implement create, update, delete, and query for contact data
用 contact.selectContacts 选择联系人并回填到发送页面 / Use contact.selectContacts to pick contacts and fill them back into a send page
申请 READ_CONTACTS 和 WRITE_CONTACTS 权限后管理联系人 / Request READ_CONTACTS and WRITE_CONTACTS before managing contacts
从通讯录读取号码用于一键发短信或拨号 / Load phone numbers from contacts for one-tap SMS or calling
同步企业通讯录到系统联系人并维护更新 / Sync an enterprise directory to system contacts and keep it updated
do_not_use_when: 需求是在锁屏、通知中心或状态栏持续展示打车、配送、航班或导航等进行中状态，应改用 live-view-kit / The requirement is to show ongoing status for rides, delivery, flights, or navigation on the lock screen, notification center, or status bar; use live-view-kit instead

需求是分享文本、图片、视频或链接到其他应用/设备，或使用智能推荐与附近设备传输，应改用 share-kit / The requirement is to share text, images, videos, or links across apps/devices, or use smart recommendations and nearby transfer; use share-kit instead
preconditions: 设备具备联系人服务能力，目标API在当前HarmonyOS版本可用 / The device has contact service capability and the target API is available in the current HarmonyOS version
若使用直接增删改查联系人API，module.json5中已声明所需联系人权限 / If using direct contact CRUD APIs, the required contacts permissions are declared in module.json5
若使用直接读取或写入联系人数据，应用已获得用户授予且受系统策略允许的联系人权限 / If directly reading or writing contact data, the app has been granted user consent and the contacts permissions are allowed by system policy
若使用Picker交互，应用能够拉起系统界面并处理选择结果回传 / If using Picker-based interaction, the app can launch the system UI and handle the returned selection result
inputs: 联系人选择或新建请求参数 / contact selection or creation request parameters
联系人字段数据（姓名、电话、邮箱等） / contact field data (name, phone, email, etc.)
联系人标识或查询条件 / contact identifier or query criteria

postconditions.statement: 若采用Picker方案，代码中已接入联系人选择或新建联系人拉起逻辑，并处理返回结果 / If using the Picker approach, the code integrates logic to launch contact selection or contact creation and handles the returned result
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show code that invokes a contact picker or contact-creation flow and processes the returned selection/result callback or promise?

postconditions.statement: 若采用直接联系人管理方案，代码中已调用联系人增删改查相关API，并与目标业务操作一致 / If using direct contact management, the code calls contact CRUD APIs consistent with the intended business operation
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set include direct contacts CRUD API usage that matches the requested action such as query, add, update, or delete?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及受限联系人权限，工程配置中已声明相应权限且代码包含权限申请或校验流程 / If restricted contacts permissions are involved, the project declares the corresponding permissions and the code includes permission request or validation flow
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, can you confirm that required contacts permissions are declared in configuration and that the app checks or requests them before protected APIs are used?
